newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-SIMMONS SIGNS NEW CONTRACT WITH LEICESTERSHIRE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SIMMONS SIGNS NEW CONTRACT WITH LEICESTERSHIRE.

text.p: West Indian all-rounder Phil Simmons signed a new two-year contract on Wednesday to continue as Leicestershire's overseas player.
"I have enjoyed my cricket at Grace Road and I am delighted to have the chance to return for the next two seasons. My target is to help us win the county championship," Simmons said.
Simmons has been one of the most successful overseas players on the county circuit this season.
He is top of Leicestershire's bowling averages having taken 48 wickets and needs just 69 runs to complete 1,000 for the season.
